segments.card:
THE COURT OF
MUSICAL APPEALS

docket 145
segments.say: The Court of Musical Appeals. Docket one four five.

segments.card:
In re: Tequila.

The league v. Conor Johnston.
One count of sanctimony.
segments.say: In re: Tequila. The league versus Conor Johnston. One count of sanctimony.

segments.card:
THE COURT:
Exhibit A. Your ballot.

>>"This competition is one big joke to you, eh?
>>A gag for you to poop on? The rest of us put
>>thought into this, effort. And you come here
>>why? To mock us for caring?"
segments.say: This competition is one big joke to you, eh? A gag for you to poop on? The rest of us put thought into this, effort. And you come here why? To mock us for caring?

segments.card:
THE COURT:
Exhibit B. Your submission,
the same week.
segments.say: Exhibit B. Your submission. The same week.

segments.card:
>>"I have no idea to this day what those 2
>>Italian ladies were signing about.
>>Truth is, I don't want to know."
segments.say: I have no idea to this day what those two Italian ladies were singing about. Truth is, I don't want to know.

segments.card:
THE COURT:
The theme was “lyrics not in English.”
segments.say: The theme was lyrics not in English.

segments.card:
THE DEFENDANT:
(parody)

I stand by my ballot.

THE COURT:
You finished last.

Two points below the man
you called ignorant.
segments.say: You finished last. Two points below the man you called ignorant.

segments.card:
THE COURT:
The court would sentence you.

The record shows you
have already done it yourself.
segments.say: The court would sentence you. The record shows you have already done it yourself.

segments.card:
>>"I went pretty hard after Tequila.
>>Then it beat me. Soooo...I should keep
>>my lard ass mouth closed."

— Conor, in the group chat, August 1
segments.say: I went pretty hard after Tequila. Then it beat me. So. I should keep my lard ass mouth closed.
